notes.title: My new game coming soon!
notes.notes:
[b]World Annihilation Operations Parts I-IV[/b] is a set of [b]4[/b] short experimental games examining the impact of audiovisual and narrative contradictions within fictional worlds. Each game showcases a vastly different world with various mechanics, and is the result of a research-based creative process meant to discover technical operations, inspired in each case by a unique act of creation and able to generate contradictions/impossible figures within initially logically "possible" worlds. 

This compilation of small games is set to come out, for free, on February 14th 2023!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2282630/World_Annihilation_Operations_Parts_IIV/
